DueWorkflowScheduleItems.reason: The legacy tick reads installed definitions and runs under the read lock. It copies only due workflow IDs, triggers and resource IDs, in definition order followed by run order, before releasing the lock for execution.

BeginWorkflowScheduleRead.reason: Retains one installed metadata generation for both scheduler loops and projects only Enabled/Trigger/NextRunAt (then ID) of definitions and Status/NextRetryAt (then WorkflowID/ResourceType/ResourceID) of runs per child under a scratch owner, visiting due items in native order with the caller's clock; Close is idempotent. large workflow actions due-read store tests plus workflow tick close/workflow tick tick differentials (weekday and Sunday clocks, exact and one-nanosecond boundaries, duplicates, cancellation) cover it.
BeginWorkflowScheduleRead.temperatureReason: Retained native definitions/runs generation for the 15-second workflow tick.
